places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: Clara's horse ranch with a frame house; Bob lies paralyzed there, and Elmira arrives exhausted, gives birth to a boy, then slips away leaving him.
places.location_hint: Nebraska, on a slope above the Platte, about twenty miles (over half a day by wagon) from Ogallala; old sod house and a knoll east of the house with three boys' graves

places.name: North Platte River
places.note: Elmira's wagon arrives along it from the west; Clara once washed her hair in its icy water and watches mists over it.
places.location_hint: river beside Clara's ranch near Ogallala, Nebraska

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Elmira asks if they have reached it yet; Clara followed Bob to its hard plains years ago.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Rough town twenty miles off where Clara seldom goes; Jules plays piano there, Cholo shops there, and Elmira hopes to find Dee Boot.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Elmira says she has come all the way from there.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Clara's piano and house money came from selling her parents' business there; she was once its most courted girl.

places.name: St. Louis
places.note: Clara ordered her piano from there.

places.raw_name: the Red River of the North
places.name: Red River of the North
places.note: Jules the piano player once traded there before smallpox ruined his business.

places.name: Dakota Territory
places.note: Jules drifted down through them to Ogallala.

places.name: Montreal
places.note: Jules's grandmother's house was there; Clara's girls remind him of his cousins.

places.name: Dismal River
places.note: Cholo survived an April blizzard there thanks to the buffalo coat Clara bought him.

places.name: Missouri
places.note: Grandparents of neighbor Maude Jones's children came from there to fetch them.

places.name: Cincinnati
places.note: Clara has an aunt there she writes to once or twice a year.

places.name: Wyoming
places.note: Clara loves watching morning light spread across the plains toward it.

places.name: England
places.note: Clara orders magazines from there and the East.

groups.label: Clara's household
groups.hint: at the ranch house on the Platte, Clara caring for Bob and Elmira's newborn boy

groups.label: Elmira with the buffalo hunters
groups.hint: left by wagon at night, heading for Ogallala about twenty miles away
